title: Rebar - Metric Reinforcing Bar
description: Reinforcing bar - European metric dimensions. Calculate properties of metric reinforcing bars based on bar number selection.

outputs.label: Mass per Meter
outputs.formula: inputs.bar_number === '10M' ? 0.785 : inputs.bar_number === '15M' ? 1.570 : inputs.bar_number === '20M' ? 2.355 : inputs.bar_number === '25M' ? 3.925 : inputs.bar_number === '30M' ? 5.495 : inputs.bar_number === '35M' ? 7.850 : inputs.bar_number === '45M' ? 11.775 : inputs.bar_number === '55M' ? 19.625 : 0

outputs.label: Nominal Diameter
outputs.formula: inputs.bar_number === '10M' ? 11.3 : inputs.bar_number === '15M' ? 16.0 : inputs.bar_number === '20M' ? 19.5 : inputs.bar_number === '25M' ? 25.2 : inputs.bar_number === '30M' ? 29.9 : inputs.bar_number === '35M' ? 35.7 : inputs.bar_number === '45M' ? 43.7 : inputs.bar_number === '55M' ? 56.4 : 0

outputs.label: Cross Sectional Area
outputs.formula: inputs.bar_number === '10M' ? 100 : inputs.bar_number === '15M' ? 200 : inputs.bar_number === '20M' ? 300 : inputs.bar_number === '25M' ? 500 : inputs.bar_number === '30M' ? 700 : inputs.bar_number === '35M' ? 1000 : inputs.bar_number === '45M' ? 1500 : inputs.bar_number === '55M' ? 2500 : 0

outputs.label: Total Mass
outputs.formula: (inputs.bar_number === '10M' ? 0.785 : inputs.bar_number === '15M' ? 1.570 : inputs.bar_number === '20M' ? 2.355 : inputs.bar_number === '25M' ? 3.925 : inputs.bar_number === '30M' ? 5.495 : inputs.bar_number === '35M' ? 7.850 : inputs.bar_number === '45M' ? 11.775 : inputs.bar_number === '55M' ? 19.625 : 0) * inputs.length
